retrievalProfile.description: A centered close-up portrait featuring a high-contrast serif title at the top and a vibrant, textured hand-painted overlay across the subject's hands.
triggerTerms: editorial portrait with lipstick paint overlay
denim jacket close-up with painted text

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, square-format portrait of a young woman in a denim jacket, framed by a large, semi-transparent serif title at the top and a thick, red impasto-style painted word across the center-bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The top serif text acts as a translucent frame for the subject's forehead.
The red painted text creates a tactile, aggressive contrast against the soft skin and denim.
The subject's hands are positioned to create a central focal point for the painted overlay.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up, head and shoulders filling the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the vibrant red paint strokes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top title, moves down to the eyes, and settles on the textured red lettering at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, solid background behind the hair to make the subject and top text pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted denim blue and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red for the painted lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red paint against a desaturated, slightly grainy photographic base.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Modern High-Contrast Serif and Expressive Script
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Extremely high contrast between thick and thin strokes; sharp, bracketed serifs.
Bottom text: Thick, gestural strokes mimicking heavy oil paint or lipstick applied with a brush.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Top text is rendered with low opacity to allow hair texture to show through.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Sophisticated editorial serif paired with raw, aggressive hand-painted texture.

preserve: High contrast of the top serif
Tactile paint texture of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast editorial look for the top title.
To achieve the specific 'lipstick on glass' or 'paint on denim' texture.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square close-up portrait of a young woman with blonde hair and a braid, wearing a denim jacket, hands held up to her face, against a dark background with a slight film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, semi-transparent white Didone serif title across the top. Overlay a thick, textured crimson red hand-painted word across the hands in the lower third.

verificationChecks: Does the red text have visible paint/brush stroke texture?
Is the composition centered and square?
Is the denim texture visible under the red paint?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on the denim
Ensure the painted text is a unique hand-drawn style
postGenerationChecks: Check that the top text doesn't obscure the eyes.
Ensure the red paint looks like it has physical volume.
Confirm the high-contrast serif has sharp edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: Editorial Portrait + Translucent Didone Header + Textured Impasto Overlay
